name: Microsoft Entra ID
description: Business connector for Microsoft Entra ID: OpenID Connect sign-in validation for the gateway and desktop, and optional read-only directory lookup of users and groups.

tenantId.description: Directory (tenant) ID GUID or verified domain, or "organizations" for a multi-tenant app (then allowedTenants is required).

clientId.description: Application (client) ID of the app registration; the expected audience of ID tokens.

allowedTenants.description: Tenant GUIDs whose users may sign in. Default: the configured tenant only.

directory.description: Directory read: off; basic = user names and addresses (User.ReadBasic.All); full = users and groups (Directory.Read.All, admin consent).
